weekly.rainfall: More than usual rainfall expected over northern parts of Ethiopia, isolated parts of western Eritrea and isolated parts of western South Sudan. Less than usual rainfall expected over central to southern regions of Sudan, most parts of South Sudan, central parts of Ethiopia, isolated areas over northern coastal Somalia, Uganda and western regions of Kenya.
weekly.temperature: Warmer than usual temperatures expected over most parts of the GHA.
weekly.heavyRain: Rainfall exceeding the 90th percentile expected over isolated areas in western to northern Ethiopia and isolated areas in northwestern South Sudan. Heavy rainfall (greater than 200 mm) expected over isolated parts of western Ethiopia.
weekly.heatStress: Elevated heat stress within the ‘Extreme Caution’ category expected over most parts of South Sudan, Sudan, Eritrea, Djibouti, central to northern Somalia and north-eastern regions of Ethiopia. Elevated heat stress within the ‘Danger’ category expected over parts of the Afar region in Ethiopia extending into parts of central Eritrea, isolated areas along the coastline of Eritrea and a few pockets over northern Sudan.
weekly.flood: No country-specific flood update is listed for Ethiopia in the latest ICPAC weekly bulletin. This does not mean there is no local flood risk.

seasonal.rainfall: For October–November–December (OND) 2026 , below-normal rainfall is favoured across much of Angola, southern Zambia, Zimbabwe, Mozambique, Namibia, Botswana, most of South Africa, Eswatini and Lesotho. Normal to above-normal rainfall is favoured over parts of the northern region, while above-normal rainfall is expected over eastern DRC, most of Tanzania, the extreme northern parts of Malawi and Zambia, and Seychelles. During January–February–March (JFM) 2027 , below-normal rainfall remains favoured across much of Angola, Namibia, Botswana, Zimbabwe, Zambia and parts of South Africa.
seasonal.temperature: The temperature outlook indicates an increased likelihood of above-average temperatures across most of the SADC region, except over some central areas where cooler-than-usual conditions are expected.

drought.text: East Africa Drought Watch does not cover Zambia. Seasonal drought context is therefore taken from SADC/SARCOF and observed CHIRPS rainfall rather than ICPAC CDI.
